title: fix(client): normalizeSessionResponse's JSDoc records the data.user.image gap as closed, not tracked
body:
Fixes #18510

Clause-②: no

The JSDoc block above `normalizeSessionResponse` says what the lift compensates for, so it names the cards that opened and closed each compensation. One clause was still in the present tense:

```text
… with one gap that is NOT this: `data.user.image` served `null` against a declared
`string | undefined` (#17235, tracked separately).
```

⚠️ Quoted in a fence, not a blockquote, deliberately: this PR must not become a delivering
reference for the card that sentence names.

Both halves went false when PR #18501 widened `SessionUserSchema.image` to `z.string().nullish()` and #17235 moved to closed. It now reads in the past tense, names the widening that closed it, and points at the residue list in `auth-login-register-envelope.test.ts` ② that is pinned empty. Nothing else in the block moves.

⭐ Located **by symbol**, never by line number: the card's `:1514-1517` had already drifted to `:1520-1531` by the time this was dispatched, and the pin added here locates the block the same way.

## Premise re-verified independently of the dispatch

Both of triage's sequencing conditions, re-read rather than inherited:

- PR #18501 is merged (`merged_at` 2026-09-16T17:44:07Z) and #17235 is `closed` / `completed` (2026-09-16T17:44:08Z).
- On the tree, located by symbol: `SessionUserSchema` is declared `lazySchema(() => z.object({…}))` in `packages/spec/src/api/auth.zod.ts`, and `image` inside it reads `z.string().nullish()`. ⚠️ The near-miss at `:111` is `RegisterRequestSchema` and was not touched.

## "Only comments changed" is NOT "nothing published moves" — measured

The card asserts the function is not exported and its comment reaches no `.d.ts`, so it "ships to nobody". That assertion was measured against the built artifacts rather than inherited, and it is **half right**.

`@objectstack/client` ships `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`. ⭐ `dist` is six files — `index.js`, `index.mjs`, `index.d.ts`, `index.d.mts` and a `.map` beside each bundle. This package emits **no** `*.cjs` and **no** `*.d.cts`, so a `*.d.cts` probe here would measure an absent file and return a zero about nothing; the four that exist were probed instead.

Built from the same tree before and after the change:

| probe | index.js | index.mjs | index.d.ts | index.d.mts | index.js.map | index.mjs.map |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| NEG `no longer residue` (block-unique) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| NEG `data.user.image` | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| NEG `tracked separately` | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| POS `{@link normalizeSessionResponse}` | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| POS `set-auth-token` | 4 | 4 | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 |

- **The block's own text ships nowhere** — the negative probes are zero across all six while the positive controls land, so this is a discrimination, not a dead probe.
- **But comment text from this file DOES reach the published types.** `{@link normalizeSessionResponse}` appears 3× in each `.d.ts`, carried there by the JSDoc of the **exported** `auth.login` / `auth.register` / `auth.me` that link to it. The card's reason is the load-bearing half: the block does not ship because the function it documents is not exported — not because comments in this file do not ship.
- **And the published bytes DO move.** `index.js`, `index.mjs`, `index.d.ts` and `index.d.mts` are byte-identical across the change (sha256, with the HEAD build re-run as a reproducibility control). Both `.map` files **differ**: neither carries `sourcesContent` (`pnpm check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` is why), so no comment text ships inside them either — the position table shifts because the rewritten comment is two lines longer.

⇒ `skip-changeset` would have been a false declaration. This carries a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/client`, and the measurement is recorded in the changeset body rather than left in a PR nobody greps.

## The pin

`packages/client/src/normalize-session-response-jsdoc.pin.test.ts` — ⛔ **not** a pin on the block's wording. It pins one relation: for each card on a declared closed roster (#17234, #17235, #17238, #17881, each with the state that was read), the block may cite it — past tense is the point of citing it at all — but may not carry an open-tracking phrase beside that citation. A card that really is open can still be tracked in those words.

Red before, green after, with controls that can fail:

- **red before** — on the unfixed source, exactly ② failed (`1 failed | 4 passed`), reporting `#17235`.
- **green after** — `5 passed`, inside a suite of `47 passed (47)` files / `550 passed` tests.
- **locator control ①** — the extractor must find *this* block (asserts its anchors `#17234`, `data.token`, `SessionResponseSchema`, and that it is one whole JSDoc block), and a symbol the file does not declare must yield no block. Without it an extractor returning `''` would make ② pass while measuring nothing.
- **negative control ③** — the pre-fix sentence, copied verbatim from the base, must still be reported; and the past-tense form must not be.

⚠️ ③ earned its keep on its first run: the past-tense sentence originally drafted for this fix opened *"the one gap that was still open when this was written"*, and `still open` is on the vocabulary — the rewrite would have tripped the pin written to satisfy it. The shipped sentence says "remained", and the control records why.

**Tier measured in both directions**, because adding a pin can move a whole file out of its vitest tier: the unit config's roster is 46 files before the pin file exists and 47 after, and the diff is exactly one added line — this file — with nothing dropped. `packages/client` tiers by path (`tests/integration/**` is excluded from the unit config and has its own config), so a new `src/*.test.ts` lands in the unit tier; the `vitest-tiers.ts` content-based mechanism is `packages/cli`'s and does not reach here.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client test` — **47 passed (47) files, 550 passed tests**.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client typecheck` — `tsc --noEmit` clean; `check:test-typecheck` reports the test layer compiles under `tsconfig.test.json`, 0 files / 0 errors, which is what covers the new pin file.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived **59** gate commands from the real change set (re-derived after merging `origin/main`, so the stale-tree warning the first derivation printed is cleared). **58 pass.**
- `pnpm lint` — the repo-wide union (`eslint . --no-inline-config`), **exit 0**, at `52b7812953`. ⚠️ `dispatch-gates.mjs` does not name this family; it was run anyway.
- ⛔ **NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`.** It refuses with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET … ⛔ This is NOT a pass: nothing was measured` (exit 3) because 34 packages have no `dist` — its prerequisite is a repo-wide `pnpm build`, which CI performs on a fresh checkout. It is recorded as unmeasured rather than as a pass, and this change cannot move it: the four loadable artifacts are byte-identical above.

## Acceptance notes

⛔ Noted, not filed — none is a reproducible defect, a contract violation, or a metadata-authoring trap.

1. **The card's own reach measurement is wrong, in attribution and in count.** It records the literal `data.user.image` as appearing in "**3** past-tense comments inside `packages/spec`'s own test files plus this one line in `packages/client`". At `origin/main` it appears in **2** past-tense comments inside **`packages/client`**'s own test file (`auth-login-register-envelope.test.ts:33` and `:310`), **zero** in any `packages/spec` test file, plus one changeset line and the target line. The fix is unaffected — the target was the only present-tense occurrence, which is what the card was actually about. Successor: this PR.
2. **A comment-only diff moves published bytes whenever the package emits source maps.** The shortcut "it is only a comment, so nothing publishes" is measurably false for any package shipping a `dist` with `.map` files: a comment whose line count changes shifts every mapping after it. Successor: named — the measurement is written into this PR's changeset body, so it ships to `packages/client/CHANGELOG.md` rather than staying in a PR nobody greps.
3. **Container hazard, for sibling agents on this box, not a repo defect.** `pnpm check:type-check-debt` runs a turbo build; when that build is SIGKILLed under memory pressure mid-DTS, it leaves `packages/spec/dist` with **zero** `.d.ts` files, after which unrelated packages' `typecheck` fails with a pile of `TS7016 Could not find a declaration file for module '@objectstack/spec/api'` that reads exactly like the caller's own change breaking something (AGENTS.md Multi-agent discipline §9, the `packages/spec/dist` row). ⚠️ Counter-intuitive recovery, measured here: **raising** `--max-old-space-size` made it worse (8192 and 4096 were both killed at exit 137; the cgroup kills before V8's own limit bites), and **3072** completed. Successor: this note.

Authored by the `domain:cli` execution seat in session `session_01DvvamiacK328idtBYJBxV3` (https://claude.ai/code/session_01DvvamiacK328idtBYJBxV3). ⚠️ The attribution lives in this prose line rather than a footer of its own: measured on this PR, a REST **create** stores the footer block byte-identical, while a REST **edit** APPENDS its own bare block on top of whatever the body already carries — so a body that arrives at its final text through an edit can only carry one footer by sending none.
